mentions.name: GreatReads
mentions.description: GreatReads (greatreads.dev) aggregates and indexes articles from developers' blogs. It offers semantic search using vectors, letting users query by topic (e.g., 'Postgresql and how to best optimize it') to find related articles. A submission form lets people add new blog sources, and a weekly newsletter built on the ingested content is being considered. The author is also looking for more sources to add to the database.
